messages:
sam: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A \- want a short, sharable list of why we won/lost and top asks. can owners drop 1-line statuses here?

mira: Sales view: wins = fast pilots + clear perf numbers + security docs. losses = long contracting, sticker shock on peak pricing, and missing on-prem options for regulated customers.

alex: CS: agree. top asks = VPC/on-prem timeline, token-level billing export, longer metrics retention. also requests for formal fallback policies during model spikes.

devin: Eng: runtime KV cache + adaptive batching rolling next week -> should help p95 and cost. will post benchmark gist: https://redwood.internal/bench/kv-cache (will share access).

tara: Product: customers asking for SLO packages they can purchase (latency tiers). also midmarket wants simplified per-route caps. I'll draft package options.

ben: Research: hallucination mitigation keeps coming up. customers want reranking + deterministic fallback chain (e.g., main -> reranker -> small model). tagging this as priority.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-4922 "AH: customer wins/losses & asks" assigned to mira, devin, tara.

sam: ask: owners please add a 1-line customer-facing message + ETA to the ticket by Monday EOD. we need something for partners call.

mira: will add pricing playbook note + sample table.

devin: will add perf SLO draft + link to microbench by Wed.

tara: will sketch SLO packages and midmarket cap options by EOW.

sam: thanks all. short, actionable. i'll circulate a 1-paragraph summary after tickets updated. :thumbsup:
